summary_en: 150,000 shares to be cancelled (1.09% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Post-cancellation issued shares: 13,560,000. Effective date 2026-08-20.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: SERAKU Co., Ltd. announced on 6 August 2026 that its Board of Directors has resolved, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, to cancel 150,000 treasury shares. The cancellation is scheduled for 20 August 2026. The shares represent 1.09% of shares outstanding (computed as 150,000 ÷ 13,710,000 shares ex-treasury). Following cancellation, total issued shares will be 13,560,000, and remaining treasury shares will number 471,105 (3.47% of post-cancellation issued capital).
